Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
We have a Weber Performer grill and have used it for many years. Its starts the charcoal with propane. Cooks great and has provided years of use. Wanted a new grill for weekend house and wanted it to fire up fast, so gas was the only way to go. Found the Spirit II online and at Lowes AND in red! We just had our first outdoor gathering and the Spirit was fantastic! AND FAST! I can control temperature much better with the Spirit as compared to the Performer. Folks commented on how well the chicken and steak turned out. 
On both my grills I have "leveling" issues, because the patios are graded for water to run off and then the grill is out of level. This isn't good. I have to prop and shim up  the legs. Would suggest that at least one side of the grill legs or wheel be height adjustable. Levelers on all legs would be awesome. Maybe invent/offer a optional leveler "kit". Be the way, it pretty apparent that the legs are "engineered" to be as light as possible and the plastic wheels are cheap.

If there is anything else we can help with, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at reviews@weberstephen.com and we would be happy to help. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText:
The Bad

I returned the first grill I purchased due to scratches/scrapes on the lid. The replacement had a bent part (#25) that forms the base and holds the tank that Weber replaced. I have also had trouble with the pressure regulator, but have not replaced it as yet. While assembly was fairly easy, it could have been made simpler with more written instructions and kitting the nuts and bolts with major part assemblies. I spent lots of time making certain I had the right parts nuts and bolts which could have been avoided with part coding and kitting. 

The Good

Starts easy and cooks evenly. The red grill is good looking have used the grill 10-15 times and it looks like once past the quality control issues it will be a great performer. I hope it lasts as long as my prior Weber Grills.
Results.Title: Bad beginning for a Weber product

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
